definitions.full: H7487. ra 'anan רַעֲנַן adjective flourishing (perhaps loan-word from Biblical Hebrew רַעֲנָן luxuriant , √ רען ); — figurative of person Dan 4:1 (compare Biblical Hebrew Psa 92:15 ).
